<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-11-2703-34-48" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:yid_dpyod">
            <milestone unit="section" n="(iii) yid dpyod"/>
        yid dpyod la gsum las
         <milestone unit="section" n="iii.1 mtshan nyid"/>
        mtshan nyid la bzhi ste | gzhan gyi lugs dgod pa dang | de sun dbyung ba dang | rang gi lugs rnam par gzhag pa dang | de la brtsod pa spang ba'o ||
         <milestone unit="section" n="iii.11 gzhan lugs dgod pa - rgya"/>
         dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> na re yid dpyod kyi mtshan nyid myong ba dang rtag la ma brten par don nges tsam yin no zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
